Class ShipBoardGraphics

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytrucker.ui.gui.shipBoardControllers.ShipBoardGraphics
Direct Known Subclasses:
FlightPhaseControllerL1, FlightPhaseControllerL2, ShipBoardControllerL1, ShipBoardControllerL2, ShipBuildingControllerL1, ShipBuildingControllerL2, ShipControlControllerL1, ShipControlControllerL2
public abstract class ShipBoardGraphics extends Object
This class contains all the methods needed to show a specific component of a ship board, including batteries, crew members, aliens, goods and providing the correct size and orientation of the component.

    • setImageOnGrid

      public abstract void setImageOnGrid(String imageID, Orientation orientation, int column, int row)
      Sets an image on the grid pane at the specified column and row with the given orientation.
      Parameters:
      imageID - The ID of the image to be set.
      orientation - The orientation of the image (e.g., HORIZONTAL, VERTICAL).
      column - The column index in the grid pane.
      row - The row index in the grid pane.

    • setComponentOnGrid

      public void setComponentOnGrid(ViewComponent component, int row, int column)
      Sets a component on the grid pane at the specified row and column. This method updates the grid with the component's image, orientation, and any additional attributes like batteries, crew members, aliens, or goods.
      Parameters:
      component - The ViewComponent to be set on the grid.
      row - The row index in the grid pane.
      column - The column index in the grid pane.

    • removeComponentFromGrid

      public void removeComponentFromGrid(int row, int column)
      Removes a component from the grid pane at the specified row and column. This method searches for the component in the grid and removes it, including any associated images or overlays.
      Parameters:
      row - The row index in the grid pane.
      column - The column index in the grid pane.
